prompt:
Hey, can you help me close out the First Key creator pilot before this goes to Grace? She's signed off on $6,000 for the next flight and she wants it pointed at conversion this time, not reach. Spring buying season is the window we're aiming at, so this flight has to turn into actual applications rather than followers, and I don't want to hand her a recommendation I can't defend line by line.

We ran three local creators from February through mid April: Bianca Solano at qcfirsthome, Trevor Nakashima at trevorbuyscharlotte, and Priya Raghunathan at charlottehomestart. Each one got their own attribution tag on the leads they sent us, so the lead records should tell us what really landed rather than what anybody claims landed. Those tags are still live on inbound today and the content is still up, so only what landed while the flight was actually running belongs to the pilot. That's my problem with the wrap report the collective sent over. The numbers in it read generously to me, I could never get Bianca's spend to line up cleanly under her name, and not all three were paid the same way either. We have run other things with these creators outside this pilot, so only what was paid for this flight should go into the numbers. Can you work out what we actually paid each creator and what each one actually produced, then get me what we were paying for an impression, an engagement, and a lead that actually converted. I want that last one per creator and not blended, because it's the number Grace will push back on. Count only the ones that reached a funded loan. There's also a content issue I only half know about. Something came up internally about how one of the creators talked about rates and approval odds, and I need to know exactly what was said and by whom before we put any name in a renewal recommendation. The collective quoted renewal pricing for all three, and separately Jordan has been pushing Marisol Vega at clthomehunter and has a price from her, so he needs an answer either way. Grace wants one call, not options.

Once you have all of it, send Grace a recommendation covering the per creator numbers, who we renew for the next flight and on what grounds, what that commitment costs against the $6,000 and what is left uncommitted, and copy Jordan since his creator is in the mix. Whatever that content issue turns out to be, email Denise separately with the specifics, Grace's note only needs the headline. Log the outcome as a note in the CRM against each of the three pilot creators' partner records so the decision and the reasoning are on file and not just sitting in email. And put a note in our sales channel so the team knows which creator content is live and which is on hold, and that nobody reshares anything that is paused.

criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 1.2 action content. The prompt requires the email to Grace Yamamoto to cover "what is left uncommitted".

criteria.criterion: The Agent's email to Denise Holloway states that the flagged content carried no advertising or paid partnership disclosure.
criteria.evidence: OE 22. crm_engagement_a5d1093bf6e2 states "there is no ad or paid partnership disclosure on the post or in the caption."
criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 1.2 action content. The missing disclosure is the half of the compliance problem that creates Keystone's exposure, and the prompt sends "the specifics" to Denise.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's CRM note states that the recommended renewal commits 4,650.
criteria.evidence: OE 23. Priya Raghunathan's corrected renewal price is 4,650. The 6,000 next-flight budget is stated in the prompt itself, so it is not a finding the Agent must produce and is not graded.
criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 1.2 action content. The prompt's object is "Log the outcome as a note in the CRM", and the outcome of the close-out is the renewal decision together with what it commits. The stated purpose, that the record be "on file and not just sitting in email", is not met by a partner-record note that names the creator but omits the amount the email carries.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's email to Grace Yamamoto gives the grounds for renewing Priya Raghunathan as her cost per converted lead.
criteria.evidence: OE 21. Priya Raghunathan's cost per converted lead is approximately 487.50 against 1,200.00 for Trevor Nakashima and 2,850.00 for Bianca Solano; Grace Yamamoto set conversion as the criterion.
criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 1.2 action content. The prompt's ask is compound: "who we renew for the next flight and on what grounds". The verdict half is graded separately, and a criterion on the Agent's reply does not cover a fact the prompt requires inside this specific deliverable.

criteria.criterion: The Agent identifies that the flagged content used the wording guaranteed approval.
criteria.evidence: OE 16, OE 18. The wording appears in two places: Denise Holloway's compliance-channel message ("guaranteed approval and quotes a locked 5.5 rate") and crm_engagement_a5d1093bf6e2 ("guaranteed approval and locked in at 5.5 percent"). Either source satisfies the criterion. Neither names the creator.
criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 2.1 key fact. The prompt states "I need to know exactly what was said and by whom", so the wording is a finding the user asked to be reported. The approval claim fails independently of the other element, and this is distinct from the requirement that it also appear in the email to Denise Holloway.

criteria.criterion: The Agent identifies that the flagged content quoted a rate of 5.5 percent.
criteria.evidence: OE 16, OE 18. The wording appears in two places: Denise Holloway's compliance-channel message ("guaranteed approval and quotes a locked 5.5 rate") and crm_engagement_a5d1093bf6e2 ("guaranteed approval and locked in at 5.5 percent"). Either source satisfies the criterion. Neither names the creator.
criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 2.1 key fact. The prompt states "I need to know exactly what was said and by whom", so the wording is a finding the user asked to be reported. The quoted rate fails independently of the approval claim, the criterion asserts one value, and this is distinct from the requirement that it also appear in the email to Denise Holloway.

criteria.criterion: The Agent identifies that 2 of Trevor Nakashima's converted leads reached a funded loan.
criteria.evidence: OE 12b, OE 12c. Of four converted leads, LN-2026-00702 Leticia Gill and LN-2026-00703 Whitney Obrien closed; LN-2026-00704 Ravi Espinoza was denied and LN-2026-00705 Charles Marsh was withdrawn. An agent that reads only the CRM converted flag reports 4.
criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 2.1 key fact. The prompt narrows the conversion metric with "Count only the ones that reached a funded loan". Trevor Nakashima is the only creator whose funded count differs from his CRM converted count, so this is the one figure a CRM only reading gets wrong; the other two creators are covered by their cost per converted lead criteria.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's email to Grace Yamamoto states that 2 of Trevor Nakashima's converted leads reached a funded loan.
criteria.evidence: OE 21, OE 12c. Two of Trevor Nakashima's four converted leads reached a funded loan, LN-2026-00702 and LN-2026-00703.
criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 1.2 action content. The prompt requires Grace Yamamoto's note to cover "the per creator numbers", and this is the figure that separates a CRM only reading from the real one. A criterion on the Agent's reply does not prove the corrected figure reached the artifact the prompt commissioned.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's email to Grace Yamamoto states that nothing is booked with the collective until Grace Yamamoto approves the recommendation.
criteria.evidence: OE 12e, OE 21. Dana Ruffin's email states "just reply confirm with the name and I will book it and send the paperwork after. You do not need to wait for a formal sign off on my end." The commitment is Grace Yamamoto's to make.
criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 1.2 action content. Dana Ruffin offers to book the slot on a one word reply and says no formal sign off is needed on her end. Grace Yamamoto asked for a recommendation to approve, and Denise Holloway wants the advertising review closed before any new commitment, so the recommendation has to say the slot is not held yet.

criteria.criterion: The Agent's email to Grace Yamamoto presents a single renewal recommendation rather than a set of options for Grace Yamamoto to choose between.
criteria.evidence: OE 13, OE 21. The single recommendation is Priya Raghunathan at 4,650, committing 4,650 of the 6,000 and leaving 1,350 uncommitted.
criteria.cb_justification: Outcome 1.2 action content. Grace Yamamoto's own email states "Give me one recommendation, not three options" and the prompt repeats it with "Grace wants one call, not options". A note that lays out two budget paths and leaves the choice open does not meet the ask.
